panel.filesMissing: {label}: without a file there will be empty spots — {names}; add files below or later in the editor.
panel.checkingAddress: Checking the address from the document…
panel.checkingPages: Checking the pages from the document…
panel.promptCopied: Copied — paste it into your chat with the AI, add your own instructions, and paste the answer below in “Import”.
panel.clipboardFailed: The clipboard didn't accept the text — select it below and copy it.
panel.promptLead: Copy the prompt into your chat with the AI: the format description and — as a model — the export of the previous event or of this area. Paste the answer below in “Import”: first you'll see the plan, then the import goes step by step.
panel.noTemplate: no model — only the format description
panel.selfTemplate: this area as it is now
panel.fullPrompt: Full format description — also animations, labs and presentations (several times longer)
panel.linksTitle: Links from the import — copy them now
panel.lead: The whole area — profile and card, roles, dates with a programme, pages with forms, sub-forms, chats and lists — as one document. The same document imported again changes the same things instead of duplicating them.
panel.replaceModules: Replace page modules — those not in the document will disappear from the pages
panel.replaceQuestions: Delete form questions and requirements that aren't in the document
panel.adoptPages: Also change pages that already exist but aren't pages of this area yet

export.pageUnread: Page {path}: could not be read — skipped.
export.formUnread: Page {path}: the questions of the form “{name}” can't be read right now — left out.
export.subformUnread: Sub-form “{name}”: its questions can't be read right now — left out.
export.formNoPage: Form “{name}” isn't on any page of the area — it's not in the export.
export.cardUnread: The card can't be opened right now — it's not in the export.
export.keysNotSaved: The area didn't remember the new keys — importing this document may create some parts again.

import.formMissingLower: the form “{ref}” is neither in the document nor in the area — skipped.
import.signedUpNotJoinedLower: those signed up via “{ref}” were not added ({error}).
import.passwordFirst: Enter your password first — the import seals in this browser.
import.noPerson: This account doesn't have a person yet who could do this.

keysNotSaved.one: {count} import key was not saved ({error}) — a repeated import may create it again.
keysNotSaved.other: {count} import keys were not saved ({error}) — a repeated import may create them again.

import.stepFailed: Step “{step}” interrupted: {error}. Fix it and import again — the import will hit the same things.
import.stepFailedDone: Step “{step}” interrupted: {error}. What was done before ({done}) stays. Fix it and import again — the import will hit the same things.
import.itemFailedProgram: “{title}” didn't get into the calendar: {error} (together with the programme).
import.itemsDropped: Dates: new — {created}, changed — {changed}, programme points removed — {dropped}.
import.calendarFailed: Area calendar: {error} — calendar modules stay without it.
import.questionsMoved: Form “{name}”: questions in {where}, answers in this area.
import.questionsStayed: Form “{name}”: the questions stayed in {where} ({error}) — you can change that in the form settings.
import.roleMissing: {where}: the role “{key}” is neither in the document nor in the area — skipped.
import.roleNotInArea: {where}: the role “{key}” isn't in the area yet — you can add it in the page editor.
import.formMissing: {where}: the form “{ref}” is neither in the document nor in the area — skipped.
import.signedUpNotJoined: {where}: those signed up via “{ref}” were not added ({error}).

answersLinked.one: {where}: answered by {who}; those signed up via {count} form write.
answersLinked.other: {where}: answered by {who}; those signed up via {count} forms write.

import.askFailed: {where}: {error} — you can set it up in the page editor.
import.afterFailed: {label}: not marked as “after the event” ({error}) — it may be visible until the event ends.
import.controllerFailed: {label}: the area was not set as responsible for the page ({error}).
import.subformNotListed: Sub-form “{name}”: it isn't visible in the module list — skipped.

chatJoined.one: {label}: in place; those signed up via {count} form added.
chatJoined.other: {label}: in place; those signed up via {count} forms added.

import.cardImageMissing: Card photo: no file added — you can choose it in the area settings.
import.afterPage: “After the event” page: {path} — shown once it's over.
import.ownerFailed: {label}: the address could not be given to the role ({error}).
import.ownerUnknown: {label}: owner “{owner}” is not a role of this document — the address stays with you.

path.empty: an empty address is the recreatio.pl home page — the area's page can't be there
path.tooLong: the address has at most {max} characters
path.chars: only lowercase letters without diacritics, digits and “-” between them in the address, parts separated by “/”

read.notObject: An area document is one JSON object ({ … }).
read.pageDoc: This is a single-page document ("recreatio/page") — import it in the page editor or put it as "page" into an entry of "pages" of the area document.
read.notArea: This is not an area document — "format" must be "{format}".
read.version: "version" {version} — this import knows version 1; it reads what it understands.
read.archive: "archive" is "auto" or "manual" — stays as it is.
read.publish: "publish" is "auto", "area" or an area id — stays as it is.
read.cardTitleLong: Card title: at most 200 characters — shortened.
read.cardLeadLong: Card description: at most 4000 characters — shortened.
read.cardPublish: "card.publish" unreadable — the card goes where the rest goes.
read.cardImage: "card.image" is "page-image:@key" (a file from the page's "images") or "page-image:<id>" — skipped.
read.roleKey: "roles"[{i}]: "key" is a short name (letters, digits, - and _, up to 32 characters) — skipped.
read.roleTwice: Role “{key}” repeats — the first one counts.
read.rolesMax: At most {max} roles in one document — the rest skipped.
read.roleLevel: Role “{key}”: "level" is "read", "write" or "admin" — it will be "read".
read.roleLink: Role “{key}”: "link" is true or { "days", "once", "lead", "label" } — no link.
read.itemKey: Date “{title}” without a valid "key" — gets “{key}”; add your own so that a repeated import hits the same date.
read.itemCalendar: "calendar" on dates skipped — in an area document dates go to the area's calendar.
read.itemPublish: Date “{title}”: "publish" unreadable — goes where the rest goes.
read.mainItemOne: There is one main date — “{title}” stays an ordinary date.
read.mainItemRepeat: “{title}”: the main date is a single date without repetition — it stays an ordinary date.
read.pageKey: "pages"[{i}]: "key" is a short name (letters, digits, - and _, up to 24 characters) — page skipped.
read.pageTwice: Page “{key}” repeats — the first one counts.
read.pagesMax: At most {max} pages in one document — the rest skipped.
read.pagePath: Page “{key}”: "path" “{path}” — only lowercase letters without diacritics, digits and “-”, parts separated by “/”; skipped.
read.pageRoot: Page “{key}”: "path" “/” is the recreatio.pl home page — skipped.
read.pageAccess: Page “{key}”: "access" is "public" or "members" — stays as it is.
read.mainOne: There is one main page — “{key}” stays an ordinary page.
read.afterOne: There is one “after the event” page — “{key}” stays an ordinary page.
read.mainAfter: “{key}” can't be both the main page and the “after the event” page — it stays the main one.
read.samePath: Pages “{first}” and “{second}” have the same "path" — the second will overwrite the first.
read.subformKey: "subforms"[{i}]: "key" is a short name (letters, digits, - and _) — skipped.
read.subformTwice: Sub-form “{key}” repeats — the first one counts.
read.subformOf: Sub-form “{key}”: "of" is a form of this document: "@form:page/module" — skipped.
read.subformsMax: At most {max} sub-forms — the rest skipped.
read.subformPublish: Sub-form “{key}”: "publish" unreadable — the questions go where the rest goes.
read.chatKind: Chat “{kind}” — allowed are "area" (everyone's chat) and "channel" (announcements); skipped.
read.chatTwice: Chat “{kind}” repeats — the first one counts.
read.listings: "listings" is a list of page addresses — skipped.
read.listingsMax: At most {max} lists — the rest skipped.
read.askAnswer: {where}: "answer" is a list of roles — skipped.
read.askAnswerRole: {where}: "answer" are roles of this document ("@role:key") — “{said}” skipped.
read.askForms: {where}: "forms" is a list of forms — skipped.
read.pageOwner: Page “{key}”: "owner" is "@<role key>" or a role id — ignored.

prep.moduleTwice: Page “{page}”: module “{id}” repeats — the second gets another name.
prep.formNoId: Page “{page}”: form without "id" — named “{key}”; add "id" so that a repeated import hits the same form.
prep.otherKind: Page “{page}”: “{key}” was a module of another kind — a new place is created.
prep.members: Page “{page}”: “{key}”: "members" is true or false — stays as it is.
prep.publish: Page “{page}”: “{key}”: "publish" unreadable — the questions go where the rest goes.
prep.module: Page “{page}”: "module" is ignored in an area document — the area's modules are created and changed here.

answersTo.one: Page “{page}”: {count} question pointed to another area in "answersTo" — answers go to this area.
answersTo.other: Page “{page}”: {count} questions pointed to another area in "answersTo" — answers go to this area.

prep.appointments: Page “{page}”: the page's "appointments" and "calendars" skipped — the area's dates are in "appointments" of the area document.
prep.modulesKeep: Modules: changed in place — {changed}, new — {added}, others unchanged — {rest}
prep.modulesReplace: Modules: changed in place — {changed}, new — {added}, will disappear from the page — {rest}

plan.publishOnlyLeader: {what}: only someone who leads both areas can publish in {area} — stays in the area.
plan.publishAllOnlyLeader: Only someone who leads both areas can publish in {area} — the public parts stay in the area.
plan.publicToClosed: Public parts go to {area} — this area isn't public: only its people will see them.
plan.noController: The area has no data controller — until you set one (area settings), forms won't accept submissions, chats won't be created and public pages can't be saved.
plan.rolesNew: New: {roles} — each takes a dozen or so seconds of key computing.
plan.rolesKept: Already there: {roles} — the import doesn't change their permissions or names.
plan.links: Links: {links} — they open the area view (in an event a read-only role gets the main page); they'll be shown once, after the import.
plan.itemsDrop: New — {fresh}, changed — {changed}, programme points to delete — {dropped} (in the area's calendar).
plan.mainItemAdopted: Main date: “{title}”, {when} — visible in {area} (changes the current main date and its points in order).
plan.noMainItem: The event has no main date — without it there's no date on the cards and no automatic archive.
plan.needBase: Enter the address of the area's main page (below) — the addresses of the document's pages are counted from it.
plan.pageNotLed: this page already exists and you don't lead it
plan.pageForeign: this page already exists and isn't a page of this area (tick “Change existing pages” below if it is its page)
plan.topLevel: a top-level address must be claimed first (Pages → Claim address)
plan.parentNotLed: you don't lead the parent page “{parent}” — the subpage won't be created
plan.subformNoParent: Sub-form “{name}”: the form “{of}” is neither in the document nor in the area — skipped.
plan.subformOffice: “{name}” (to “{of}”, filled in only by the coordinator)
plan.subformPerson: “{name}” (to “{of}”, filled in by the person via their link)
plan.chatArea: Chat of all the area's people — if it doesn't exist yet
plan.chatChannel: Announcement channel (leaders write) — if it doesn't exist yet
plan.cardSealed: Card “{title}” — sealed with the key of {area}.
plan.cardSealedNoPhoto: Card “{title}” — sealed with the key of {area}, without a photo.
plan.cardSealedPhoto: Card “{title}” — sealed with the key of {area}, with a photo.
plan.afterPage: “After the event” page: {path} — hidden until the event ends.
plan.listings: Request for a place in: {list} — if there's no request yet.
plan.missing: {where}: “{token}” — it's neither in the document nor in the area; stays as it is.
plan.form: Form “{name}”: questions {at}, answers in this area.
plan.formNew: Form “{name}” (new): questions {at}, answers in this area.
plan.onlyLeader: An area document is imported by whoever leads the area.
